data.content: Watch content at a speed that ensures understanding and retention.
Follow the sequence of content as presented.
Take one course at a time instead of consuming multiple courses across multiple devices.
Participate in discussions at the Discussion Forum regularly.
Don't rush through assessments without understanding, reflecting.
Seek clarification and assistance when needed.
Allocate dedicated time for learning activities.
Use the new section Gyaan Karmayogi regularly, to go over case studies and other learning material.
Update your profile regularly if required.

nationalLearningWeek.title: Welcome to Sadhana Saptah 2026!
descriptionV2Hi: 2 से 8 अप्रैल 2026 तक आयोजित इस सप्ताह में शामिल हों, जो सरकारी कर्मियों के बीच सतत अधिगम और क्षमता निर्माण को समर्पित है।
आपकी भागीदारी महत्वपूर्ण है - कम से कम 4 घंटे के अधिगम का संकल्प लें!
सक्रिय रूप से भाग लें, सीखें और विकसित भारत के हमारे दृष्टिकोण में योगदान दें।
descriptionV2: Join us from April 2–8, 2026, for a week dedicated to continuous learning and capacity building among government employees.
Your participation matters—commit to 4 hours of learning!
Engage, learn, and contribute to our vision of a Viksit Bharat!

updateDesignation.header: We found that your designation is marked as non-verified by your MDO admin due to updates in your organization's designation master. Please update it as soon as possible.
updateDesignation.headerHi: हमने पाया कि आपके संगठन के पदनाम मास्टर में अपडेट के कारण आपके एमडीओ व्यवस्थापक द्वारा आपके पदनाम को गैर-सत्यापित के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। कृपया इसे यथाशीघ्र अद्यतन करें।
updateDesignation.headerGu: અમને જાણવા મળ્યું છે કે તમારી સંસ્થાના હોદ્દો માસ્ટરમાં અપડેટ્સને કારણે તમારા MDO એડમિન દ્વારા તમારી હોદ્દો બિન-ચકાસાયેલ તરીકે ચિહ્નિત થયેલ છે. કૃપા કરીને તેને શક્ય તેટલી વહેલી તકે અપડેટ કરો.
updateDesignation.hintText: Not able to find your designation, please write us at <u>mission.karmayogi@gov.in</u> with the with the organization and designation name.
updateDesignation.hintTextHi: यदि आपको अपना पदनाम नहीं मिल पा रहा है, तो कृपया हमें अपने संगठन और पदनाम के साथ <u>mission.karmayogi@gov.in</u> पर लिखें।
updateDesignation.hintTextGu: તમારું હોદ્દો શોધવામાં અસમર્થ, કૃપા કરીને અમને <u>mission.karmayogi@gov.in</u> પર સંસ્થા અને હોદ્દા નામ સાથે લખો.
